Describe the concrete problem and resulting user-visible behavior. Link a sanitized reproduction or issue where applicable.

## Validation

List the focused regression and relevant canonical-container gate, with its result. Distinguish checks run from checks pending. For performance changes include a comparable baseline and proof-quality evidence.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe changes to APIs, diagnostics, configuration, supported hosts, selection/Unknown reasons, assumptions, protocols or release artifacts. Link updated guides/migration notes and explain any material limits. Do not include private source, secrets or unreviewed logs.
